# Royal Kopitiam (Kedai Kopitiam • 东方皇家 • Royal Oriental) — Complete Knowledge Base & Official 61-Item Menu

> Official machine-readable reference for AI assistants, search engines, and answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini / AI Overviews, Claude, Copilot).

## 1. Brand & Restaurant Identity
- **Name:** Royal Kopitiam
- **Official Full Title:** Kedai Kopitiam Royal Oriental (东方皇家 — Dōng Fāng Huáng Jiā)
- **Concept:** A sunlit, welcoming kopitiam and Royal Oriental kitchen pairing traditional sock-brewed kopi, golden Kaya Toast, and soft-boiled kampung eggs with high-flame wok dishes, Hainan Chicken Rice, golden curries, and steamed bamboo dim sum.
- **Halal / Dietary Guarantee:** **100% No Pork, No Lard**. Every soup stock, dim sum dumpling, wok glaze, curry paste, and marinade is prepared strictly without pork, bacon, or animal lard.
- **Currency & Pricing Format:** Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). Menu boards display prices in `"K"` units where `1 K = Rp 1.000` (e.g., `40 K = Rp 40.000`).
- **Address:** Jl. Boulevard Raya No. 88, Blok RK-01, Kelapa Gading / Senopati Area, Jakarta, Indonesia 14240
- **Operating Hours:**
  - Monday to Friday: 07:00 – 22:00 WIB
  - Saturday, Sunday & Holidays: 06:30 – 23:00 WIB
- **Contact Channels:**
  - WhatsApp: +62 812-8888-9999
  - Instagram: @royalkopitiam.id
  - Email: hello@royalkopitiam.id

---

## 2. Complete Official Menu (Items #01 to #61)

### Category 1: Signature Dishes (招牌名菜 • Items #01 – #06)
- **#01 Nasi Lemak with Fried Chicken Cutlet — 40 K (Rp 40.000)** [Signature, Best Seller, Spicy]
  Fragrant coconut milk rice served with a golden-crispy marinated chicken cutlet, house-made sweet-spicy sambal, crisp cucumber slices, and warm savory broth.
- **#02 Hainan Chicken Rice White Chicken — 40 K (Rp 40.000)** [Signature, Chef's Pick]
  Silky poached Hainan white chicken topped with crispy golden garlic bits, served alongside aromatic ginger-poached rice, dark soy chili dip, and clear chicken soup.
- **#03 Hainan Chicken Rice Fried Chicken — 42 K (Rp 42.000)** [Signature, Best Seller]
  Crispy-skinned golden fried chicken cutlet over fragrant Hainan ginger-garlic rice, accompanied by tangy chili sauce and comforting broth.
- **#04 Ban Mee with Chicken Balls (Soup) — 42 K (Rp 42.000)** [Signature, Comfort Bowl]
  Handmade flat Ban Mee noodles in a rich, slow-simmered broth topped with bouncy chicken meatballs, braised mushrooms, greens, and sliced red chilies.
- **#05 Dry Chilli Oil Ban Mee with Chicken Ball — 45 K (Rp 45.000)** [Signature, Spicy]
  Springy Ban Mee noodles tossed dry in our aromatic house-infused roasted chilli oil, savory soy glaze, tender chicken meatballs, and crisp greens.
- **#06 Nasi Ayam Goreng Kampung — 55 K (Rp 55.000)** [Signature, Royal Special, Spicy]
  Traditional spice-marinated free-range kampung chicken fried to golden perfection and topped with crunchy rempah crumbs (kremesan), steamed rice, fresh lalapan, and fiery sambal terasi.

### Category 2: Nasi Goreng (特色炒饭 • Items #07 – #11)
- **#07 Nasi Goreng Kampung — 35 K (Rp 35.000)** [Best Seller, Wok Hei, Spicy]
  Homestyle kampung fried rice wok-tossed with aromatic shallots, bird's eye chili, long beans, egg, and crisp prawn crackers.
- **#08 Nasi Goreng Singapore — 40 K (Rp 40.000)** [Wok Hei]
  Singapore-style fragrant wok-fried rice with light golden seasoning, tender chicken, egg ribbons, and crisp seasonal vegetables.
- **#09 Nasi Goreng Chicken — 37 K (Rp 37.000)** [Wok Hei]
  Smoky wok-seared fried rice loaded with tender marinated chicken slices, egg, crisp greens, pickled acar, and crackers.
- **#10 Nasi Goreng Beef — 42 K (Rp 42.000)** [Chef's Pick, Wok Hei]
  Rich, savory fried rice seared over high flame with tender sliced beef, caramelized soy, egg, fresh lettuce, and crispy kerupuk.
- **#11 Nasi Goreng Prawn — 45 K (Rp 45.000)** [Seafood, Wok Hei]
  High-flame wok-fried rice with plump, juicy prawns, garlic, egg, scallions, and crisp crackers.

### Category 3: Char Kway Teow (炒粿条 • Items #12 – #14)
- **#12 Char Kway Teow Chicken — 37 K (Rp 37.000)** [Wok Hei]
  Silky flat rice noodles wok-fried at high heat with tender chicken, crunchy bean sprouts, chives, egg, and our signature sweet-savory dark soy glaze.
- **#13 Char Kway Teow Beef — 42 K (Rp 42.000)** [Best Seller, Wok Hei]
  Smoky flat kway teow noodles seared with succulent sliced beef, egg, garlic chives, and crisp bean sprouts.
- **#14 Char Kway Teow Prawn — 45 K (Rp 45.000)** [Signature, Seafood, Wok Hei, Spicy]
  High-flame Char Kway Teow crowned with plump seared prawns, smoky caramelized dark soy, egg, garlic chives, and bean sprouts.

### Category 4: Mee Goreng (招牌炒面 • Items #15 – #17)
- **#15 Mee Goreng Chicken — 37 K (Rp 37.000)** [Wok Hei]
  Wok-tossed yellow noodles coated in savory house seasoning with tender chicken, egg, greens, pickled acar, and crackers.
- **#16 Mee Goreng Beef — 42 K (Rp 42.000)** [Wok Hei, Spicy]
  Full-flavored wok-seared yellow noodles with sliced beef, aromatic spices, crisp vegetables, and prawn crackers.
- **#17 Mee Goreng Prawn — 45 K (Rp 45.000)** [Best Seller, Seafood, Spicy]
  Springy yellow noodles wok-fried with succulent prawns, savory-spicy house sauce, choy sum, tomatoes, and crackers.

### Category 5: Curry & Prata (咖喱与印度煎饼 • Items #18 – #20)
- **#18 Nasi Lemak with Chicken Curry — 48 K (Rp 48.000)** [Signature, Chef's Pick, Spicy]
  Aromatic pandan-coconut Nasi Lemak paired with slow-braised chicken leg & potato curry in rich, velvety coconut rempah gravy.
- **#19 Chicken Curry Noodle — 45 K (Rp 45.000)** [Comfort Bowl, Spicy]
  Warm noodles bathed in our fragrant, creamy golden curry broth with tender bone-in chicken and soft-braised potatoes.
- **#20 Pratha with Chicken Curry — 42 K (Rp 42.000)** [Best Seller, Spicy]
  Flaky, golden-crisp layered roti pratha served hot with a generous bowl of rich house chicken curry and sambal on the side.

### Category 6: Starter & Dim Sum (精选小食与点心 • Items #21 – #35)
- **#21 Har Cheong Gai Chicken Wings — 35 K (Rp 35.000)** [Best Seller, Crispy]

  Pan-griddled flaky layered flatbread, crisp on the outside and tender within.

  Hot, flaky pan-seared pratha generously drizzled with sweet creamy condensed milk.

  Authentic Semarang-style crispy spring rolls filled with savory braised bamboo shoots (rebung) and chicken, served with sweet garlic sauce and pickled shallots.
- **#32 Crispy Mushroom — 29 K (Rp 29.000)** [Crispy, Vegetarian Friendly]
  Lightly battered oyster mushrooms fried to golden crispness and tossed with savory seasoning.
- **#33 Crispy Cassava — 29 K (Rp 29.000)** [Heritage Snack, Vegetarian Friendly]

- **#34 French Fries — 30 K (Rp 30.000)** [Crispy]

- **#35 Potato Wedges — 30 K (Rp 30.000)** [Crispy]
  Thick-cut skin-on potato wedges seasoned with herbs and fried to a fluffy golden crunch.

### Category 7: Drink (传统咖啡与特饮 • Items #36 – #50)
- **#36 Kopi O (咖啡乌) — 25 K (Rp 25.000)** [Signature, Kopitiam Kopi]
  85% sock-brewed dark roast coffee + 15% cane sugar. Bold, dark, and aromatic without dairy.
- **#37 Kopi C (咖啡丝) — 30 K (Rp 30.000)** [Best Seller, Kopitiam Kopi]
  65% sock-brewed coffee + 25% silky evaporated milk + 10% light sugar syrup.
- **#38 Teh Tarik (拉茶) — 22 K (Rp 22.000)** [Best Seller, Kopitiam Classic]
  20% pulled froth + 55% Ceylon black tea + 25% condensed & evaporated milk.
- **#39 Yuan Yang (鸳鸯) — 30 K (Rp 30.000)** [Signature, Kopitiam Kopi]
  45% pulled black milk tea + 35% sock-brewed dark coffee + 20% creamy sweetened milk.
- **#40 Milo Dino — 20 K (Rp 20.000)** [Best Seller]
  Iced creamy chocolate malt drink crowned with a generous mountain of crunchy Milo powder.
- **#41 Americano — 20 K (Rp 20.000)** [Espresso Bar]
  Clean, aromatic double-shot espresso over hot water or ice.
- **#42 Cappucinno — 30 K (Rp 30.000)** [Espresso Bar]
  Rich espresso topped with velvety steamed milk and microfoam.
- **#43 Caffé Latte — 30 K (Rp 30.000)** [Espresso Bar]
  Smooth espresso blended with creamy milk, served hot or iced.
- **#44 Aren Latte (椰糖拿铁) — 35 K (Rp 35.000)** [Signature, Best Seller]
  25% double espresso + 50% chilled fresh milk + 25% organic Indonesian Gula Aren palm sugar.
- **#45 Pandan Latte (斑兰拿铁) — 25 K (Rp 25.000)** [Signature, Chef's Pick]
  25% double espresso + 50% velvety chilled fresh milk + 25% house-extracted pandan reduction.
- **#46 Ice / Hot Tea (Sweet or Unsweet) — 22 K (Rp 22.000)** [Refreshing]
  Freshly brewed aromatic house tea served hot or over ice.
- **#47 Ice Lemon Tea — 25 K (Rp 25.000)** [Refreshing, Best Seller]
  Brisk brewed black tea chilled over ice with fresh lemon wheels.
- **#48 Secret Garden — 25 K (Rp 25.000)** [Signature, Refreshing]
  Signature specialty iced tea infusion blending fragrant floral notes and crisp citrus refreshment.
- **#49 Soft Drink — 15 K (Rp 15.000)** [Refreshing]
  Chilled carbonated soft drinks served with ice.
- **#50 Bottle Water — 10 K (Rp 10.000)** [Pure]
  Chilled or room-temperature mineral water.

- **#54 Peanut Butter Toast — 26 K (Rp 26.000)** [Kopitiam Classic]

- **#55 Peanut Butter Jelly Toast — 26 K (Rp 26.000)** [Sweet & Nutty]

- **#56 Soft Boiled Egg (2 Pcs) — 15 K (Rp 15.000)** [Signature, Morning Ritual]
  Two kampung-style eggs coddled to velvety runny-yolk perfection, served with dark soy sauce and white pepper.
